partnershipPlan: Two patient partners who tapered with the pathway review the consent form and the call script before submission and meet the team at 6 and 12 months to interpret results.
socialListening: None; comments from the clinic's feedback cards over the past year are read for mentions of tapering.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I agreed to come down slowly, and the calls made it feel like someone would notice if it went wrong.
items.implication: Keep the pace with the patient; the study must not add targets.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: It is two hours each way; when I stopped picking up, nobody knew why.
items.implication: Record distance and follow dispensing after disengagement.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We kept the naloxone in the kitchen and hoped we would never need it.
items.implication: Report overdose and emergency visits for everyone.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We see the missed collections first; a call to the clinic would take two minutes.
items.implication: Invite community pharmacists to flag missed collections.

summary: Four composite voices on pace, distance, overdose fear and community pharmacy signals.
